question: Will US CPI year-over-year inflation for August 2026 exceed 3.0%?
description: This market resolves based on the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), as published by the US Bureau of Labor Statistics in its monthly CPI news release for August 2026, scheduled for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET.
resolutionRules: Resolves YES if the year-over-year percentage change in CPI-U for August 2026, as first published by the BLS, is strictly greater than 3.0%. Resolves NO otherwise. Subsequent revisions are ignored; the first official release is final.
